services.name: More Exhibitions
services.desc: If you can’t make it to the Museum to visit us in person, here’s the next best thing: our online exhibitions will take you to all four corners of the world! Pirouette, Jeté, Pas…explore our newest ONLINE EXHIBITION, On Pointe, and learn all about ballet! Ballet craft included, of course! EXPLORE NOW For thousands of years, people around the world have sought to separate themselves from their shoes with all manner of socks. EXPLORE NOW The Bata Shoe Museum is very excited to be a contributor to the Google Arts and Cultural Institute, a series of collections of high-resolution images of artworks and exhibitions housed in the initiative’s partner museums. services.name: Group Tours
services.desc: Prebook your visit for groups of 12 or more to receive discounted pricing and exclusive hands-on workshop experiences celebrating the world’s largest collection of over 15,000 footwear artifacts spanning across 4,500 years of history. From ancient Egyptian sandals to celebrity stilettos, our unique museum in the heart of downtown Toronto will surprise and delight visitors of all ages and interests. Guided Tour (45 minutes) Enhance your experience with a guided tour of one or more of our current exhibitions.
